topics.name: Control Flow
subtopics: Modifier Forms of if and unless

questions.title: Integer Sign Classifier
questions.description:
Read an integer and classify it as positive, negative, or zero using an if/elsif/else statement.

Input Format:
One integer n.

Output Format:
Single line: "positive", "negative", or "zero".

Constraints:
-1000000 <= n <= 1000000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
if n > 0
  puts "positive"
elsif n < 0
  puts "negative"
else
  puts "zero"
end

questions.title: Adult or Minor with Unless
questions.description:
Read an age and print "adult" if the person is 18 or older, otherwise "minor", using an unless statement.

Input Format:
One integer age.

Output Format:
Single line: "adult" or "minor".

Constraints:
0 <= age <= 120
questions.sourcecode:
age = gets.to_i
unless age >= 18
  puts "minor"
else
  puts "adult"
end

questions.title: Day of Week from Number
questions.description:
Read an integer 1..7 and print the corresponding weekday abbreviation (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun) using a case/when statement.

Input Format:
One integer n (1..7).

Output Format:
Single line: the weekday abbreviation.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 7
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
day = case n
when 1 then "Mon"
when 2 then "Tue"
when 3 then "Wed"
when 4 then "Thu"
when 5 then "Fri"
when 6 then "Sat"
when 7 then "Sun"
end
puts day

questions.title: Square If Positive
questions.description:
Read an integer n. If n is positive, print its square; otherwise print "skip". Use modifier forms of if and unless.

Input Format:
One integer n.

Output Format:
Single line: the square (integer) or "skip".

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000
questions.subtopic: Modifier Forms of if and unless
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
puts n * n if n > 0
puts "skip" unless n > 0

questions.title: Maximum of Three Nested
questions.description:
Read three integers and print the largest one using nested if statements.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers a b c.

Output Format:
Single line: the largest integer.

Constraints:
-1000 <= a, b, c <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b, c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
if a >= b
  if a >= c
    puts a
  else
    puts c
  end
else
  if b >= c
    puts b
  else
    puts c
  end
end

questions.title: Grade Letter from Score
questions.description:
Read a numeric score (0..100) and print the letter grade: A (>=90), B (>=80), C (>=70), D (>=60), F (otherwise) using if/elsif/else.

Input Format:
One integer score.

Output Format:
Single line: the grade letter.

Constraints:
0 <= score <= 100
questions.sourcecode:
score = gets.to_i
if score >= 90
  puts "A"
elsif score >= 80
  puts "B"
elsif score >= 70
  puts "C"
elsif score >= 60
  puts "D"
else
  puts "F"
end

questions.title: ATM Withdrawal Fee Tiers
questions.description:
An ATM charges a withdrawal fee based on the amount tiered as follows: amounts below 100 incur 0 fee, 100..499 incur 2, 500..999 incur 5, and 1000 or more incur 10. Read the amount and print the fee.

Input Format:
One integer amount.

Output Format:
Single line: the fee (integer).

Constraints:
0 <= amount <= 100000
questions.sourcecode:
amount = gets.to_i
if amount < 100
  fee = 0
elsif amount < 500
  fee = 2
elsif amount < 1000
  fee = 5
else
  fee = 10
end
puts fee

questions.title: Simple Calculator Operation
questions.description:
Read a binary expression as three space-separated tokens: a op b where op is one of + - * / %. Compute and print the integer result using a case/when statement.

Input Format:
Three space-separated tokens: integer, operator, integer.

Output Format:
Single line: integer result.

Constraints:
operator in {+,-,*,/,%}; 1 <= operands <= 1000; b != 0 for / and %
questions.sourcecode:
a, op, b = gets.split
a = a.to_i
b = b.to_i
result = case op
when "+" then a + b
when "-" then a - b
when "*" then a * b
when "/" then a / b
when "%" then a % b
else 0
end
puts result

questions.title: Ticket Expiry Check Unless
questions.description:
A transit ticket is valid when days_until_expiry is 0 or more. Read the days and print "valid" or "expired" using an unless statement.

Input Format:
One integer days_until_expiry (may be negative).

Output Format:
Single line: "valid" or "expired".

Constraints:
-365 <= days_until_expiry <= 365
questions.sourcecode:
days = gets.to_i
unless days >= 0
  puts "expired"
else
  puts "valid"
end

questions.title: Triangle Sides Category Finder
questions.description:
Read three side lengths. First check the triangle inequality (each pair of sides must sum to more than the third). Then classify the triangle as equilateral, isosceles, or scalene using nested control structures. If invalid, print "invalid".

Input Format:
Three space-separated positive integers a b c.

Output Format:
Single line: "equilateral", "isosceles", "scalene", or "invalid".

Constraints:
1 <= a, b, c <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b, c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
if a + b > c && a + c > b && b + c > a
  if a == b && b == c
    puts "equilateral"
  elsif a == b || b == c || a == c
    puts "isosceles"
  else
    puts "scalene"
  end
else
  puts "invalid"
end

questions.title: Income Tax Bracket Calculator
questions.description:
Compute income tax using progressive brackets: 0% on the first 10000, 10% on the slice 10001..50000, 20% on the slice 50001..100000, 30% above 100000. Read income and print the tax formatted to two decimals using if/elsif/else.

Input Format:
One integer income.

Output Format:
Single line: tax formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= income <= 10000000
questions.sourcecode:
income = gets.to_i
if income <= 10000
  tax = 0.0
elsif income <= 50000
  tax = (income - 10000) * 0.10
elsif income <= 100000
  tax = 4000 + (income - 50000) * 0.20
else
  tax = 14000 + (income - 100000) * 0.30
end
puts "%.2f" % tax

questions.title: Shipping Cost by Zone
questions.description:
A courier service charges a base fee plus a per-kilogram rate depending on the destination zone: Zone A = $5 base + $0.50/kg, Zone B = $8 base + $0.75/kg, Zone C = $12 base + $1.00/kg. Read zone letter and weight, compute total using case/when.

Input Format:
Two space-separated tokens: zone letter (A, B, or C) and integer weight.

Output Format:
Single line: total formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
zone in {A,B,C}, 0 <= weight <= 1000
questions.blacklist: if , elsif, unless, while, until, for
questions.sourcecode:
zone, weight = gets.split
weight = weight.to_i
base, per_kg = case zone
when "A" then [5, 0.50]
when "B" then [8, 0.75]
when "C" then [12, 1.00]
else [0, 0.0]
end
total = base + per_kg * weight
puts "%.2f" % total

questions.title: Toll Booth with Carpool Flag
questions.description:
A toll booth gives a 50% discount to carpools and adds a 25% peak-hour surcharge. Read carpool flag, peak flag, and base toll, then compute the final toll using modifier forms of if and unless.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers: cp pk base (each flag is 0 or 1).

Output Format:
Single line: final toll formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= base <= 1000, each flag is 0 or 1
questions.subtopic: Modifier Forms of if and unless
questions.blacklist: case, when, while, until, for, each, times
questions.sourcecode:
cp, pk, base = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
toll = base.to_f
toll *= 0.5 if cp == 1
toll *= 1.25 unless pk == 0
puts "%.2f" % toll

questions.title: Days in Month with Leap Year
questions.description:
Read a year and month (1..12) and print the number of days in that month. February has 29 days in leap years (divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless also by 400). Use nested control structures.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers: year month.

Output Format:
Single line: the number of days in that month.

Constraints:
1 <= year <= 9999, 1 <= month <= 12
questions.sourcecode:
year, month = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
leap = (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0)
days = if month == 2
  if leap
    29
  else
    28
  end
elsif [4, 6, 9, 11].include?(month)
  30
else
  31
end
puts days

questions.title: RPG Damage Type Chart
questions.description:
An RPG applies a 2x damage multiplier for type advantages: fire>grass, water>fire, grass>water. All other matchups deal 1x. Read attacker_type, defender_type, and base_damage; compute final damage using case/when.

Input Format:
Three space-separated tokens: attacker_type defender_type base_damage.

Output Format:
Single line: integer final damage.

Constraints:
types in {fire,water,grass}, 1 <= base_damage <= 1000
questions.blacklist: if , elsif, unless, while, until, for
questions.sourcecode:
att, dfn, dmg = gets.split
dmg = dmg.to_i
multiplier = case [att, dfn]
when ["fire", "grass"] then 2
when ["water", "fire"] then 2
when ["grass", "water"] then 2
else 1
end
puts dmg * multiplier

questions.title: Parking Garage Tiered Pricing
questions.description:
A parking garage charges $5 for the first hour, $3 per hour for hours 2 through 4, and $2 per hour for hours 5 and beyond. Members (flag = 1) get a 20% discount. Read hours parked and member flag, then print the total using if/elsif/else and a modifier if.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers: hours member.

Output Format:
Single line: total formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= hours <= 1000, member in {0, 1}
questions.sourcecode:
hours, member = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
if hours <= 0
  cost = 0.0
elsif hours == 1
  cost = 5.0
elsif hours <= 4
  cost = 5.0 + (hours - 1) * 3.0
else
  cost = 5.0 + 3 * 3.0 + (hours - 4) * 2.0
end
cost *= 0.8 if member == 1
puts "%.2f" % cost

questions.title: Grade with Honors Classification
questions.description:
Given a numeric score and attendance percentage, determine the final classification. If attendance is below 75%, the student fails. Otherwise grade by score: 90..100 = A (but A+ if attendance >= 95), 80..89 = B, 70..79 = C, otherwise F. Use nested control structures combining if/elsif and case/when.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers: score attendance.

Output Format:
Single line: "fail", "A+", "A", "B", "C", or "F".

Constraints:
0 <= score <= 100, 0 <= attendance <= 100
questions.sourcecode:
score, att = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
if att < 75
  puts "fail"
else
  grade = case score
  when 90..100
    if att >= 95
      "A+"
    else
      "A"
    end
  when 80..89
    "B"
  when 70..79
    "C"
  else
    "F"
  end
  puts grade
end

questions.title: Banking Fee Waiver Matrix
questions.description:
A bank charges a monthly fee based on account type and balance. Basic accounts: $5 if balance < 1000 else $0. Premium: $0 if balance >= 5000, $2 if balance >= 1000, else $5. VIP: $0. Additionally, every transaction beyond 50 incurs $1 each, waived for VIP accounts. Read balance, transaction count, and account type, then print the total fee.

Input Format:
Three space-separated tokens: balance txn_count account_type.

Output Format:
Single line: total fee formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= balance <= 10000000, 0 <= txn_count <= 10000, account_type in {basic, premium, vip}
questions.inputconstrains: 0 <= balance <= 10000000, 0 <= txn_count <= 10000, account_type in {basic, premium, vip}
questions.sourcecode:
bal, txn, type = gets.split
bal = bal.to_i
txn = txn.to_i
base_fee = case type
when "basic"
  if bal < 1000
    5
  else
    0
  end
when "premium"
  if bal >= 5000
    0
  elsif bal >= 1000
    2
  else
    5
  end
when "vip"
  0
else
  10
end
extra = if type == "vip"
  0
elsif txn > 50
  txn - 50
else
  0
end
total = base_fee + extra
puts "%.2f" % total

questions.title: Calendar Meeting Conflict Detector
questions.description:
Two meetings are described by start and end times in 24-hour format. A meeting overlaps another if it starts before the other ends and ends after the other starts. Read two meetings (each as start_h start_m end_h end_m) and print "conflict" or "free" using if/elsif/else.

Input Format:
Two lines, each containing four space-separated integers: start_h start_m end_h end_m.

Output Format:
Single line: "conflict" or "free".

Constraints:
0 <= hour <= 23, 0 <= minute <= 59
questions.blacklist: between?, cover?, Date, Time, require, eval
questions.sourcecode:
e_sh, e_sm, e_eh, e_em = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
n_sh, n_sm, n_eh, n_em = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
existing_start = e_sh * 60 + e_sm
existing_end = e_eh * 60 + e_em
new_start = n_sh * 60 + n_sm
new_end = n_eh * 60 + n_em
if new_end <= existing_start
  puts "free"
elsif new_start >= existing_end
  puts "free"
else
  puts "conflict"
end

questions.title: Library Loan Eligibility Matrix
questions.description:
A library checks loan requests using a matrix. Patrons have a type (student, faculty, guest), a current checked-out count, an overdue flag, and a requested loan duration. Overdue patrons are denied. Otherwise each patron type has a max-books and max-days limit: student (5, 14), faculty (20, 90), guest (2, 7). Deny if current count >= max or requested days > max, otherwise approve. Use modifier if/unless and case/when.

Input Format:
Line 1: patron_type books_checked_out. Line 2: is_overdue requested_days.

Output Format:
Single line: "approved" or "denied".

Constraints:
patron_type in {student, faculty, guest}, 0 <= books_checked_out <= 1000, is_overdue in {0,1}, 1 <= requested_days <= 365
questions.subtopic: Modifier Forms of if and unless
questions.inputconstrains: patron_type in {student, faculty, guest}, 0 <= books_checked_out <= 1000, is_overdue in {0,1}, 1 <= requested_days <= 365
questions.sourcecode:
type, books = gets.split
books = books.to_i
overdue, days = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
max_books, max_days = case type
when "student" then [5, 14]
when "faculty" then [20, 90]
when "guest" then [2, 7]
else [0, 0]
end
status = "denied" if overdue == 1
status = "denied" if !status && books >= max_books
status = "denied" if !status && days > max_days
status = "approved" unless status
puts status
